items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 16
items.text: My sponsor ... gave me some good advice. ‘Take the words success and failure out of your vocabulary. Replace them with honesty and effort.’
items.attribution: “Win Or Lose,” Escondido, California, August 2001, Emotional Sobriety: The Next Frontier

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 16
items.text: No se ayuda a alguien tratando de impresionarlo; lo impresionas al tratar de ayudarlo.
items.attribution: “Destilación del espíritu”. INDIANÁPOLIS, INDIANA, AGOSTO DE 1982. Del AA Grapevine
